svg.text: Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Azure portal → Azure Virtual Desktop → Host pools → Create
Before the wizard, open Azure Subscriptions → your lab subscription → Resource providers. Check
Microsoft.DesktopVirtualization. If it is NotRegistered, have the authorized setup operator
select Register and wait for Registered; registration needs the documented subscription
permission. Do not give the daily reader account Owner just to skip this check.
Select the approved subscription and a separate disposable VDI resource group. Enter a clear
host pool name such as hp-cloudseam-personal-lab and an allowed region.
Choose Personal rather than Pooled. Use automatic personal assignment for this one learner, or
an explicitly documented direct-assignment method. Keep this a small lab/validation pool if the
Read the final cost/entitlement gate again before you add a billable VM. The wizard labels can
change; use the linked deployment guide for your current portal.
Check: The host pool draft is for one personal learner in the intended group.
